name: arthurpower
description: Curated engineering constraint plugin (v0.12.0). 25 Skills grouped into 5 families: (1) S1-S6 governance - bounded-context-guardian (S1, module boundaries), defensive-contract-validator (S2, 5 boundary classes), error-handling-enforcer (S3, typed exception rules), complexity-anti-drift (S5, threshold + refactor pattern), minimal-change-verifier (S6, 1 commit = 1 logical task); (2) Architecture & planning - architecture-change-reviewer (5-verdict pre-impl gate), writing-plans (ordered task decomposition); (3) Process gates - verification-before-completion (evidence before claims), systematic-debugging (4-phase root cause), defend-claim (claim-time anti-self-cert gate, 5 hook enforcement); (4) Dispatch - dispatching-parallel-agents (subagent orchestration); (5) Engineering discipline - spec-driven-development; v0.12.0 moves frontend-ui-engineering, performance-optimization, and security-and-hardening to user-level (~/.claude/skills/) as user-invoked skills (disable-model-invocation: true) — reachable only by manual operator trigger, no model auto-match; (6) code-review (改后预 commit 审查, dual-subagent 编排: standards-reviewer + spec-reviewer 并行, Standards+Spec 双轴, High/Medium/Low severity gate).
